name: GRouNdGAN trained model checkpoint
description: PyTorch checkpoint for the trained GRouNdGAN causal model used by upstream generate and perturb commands.
validation_notes: The file must be loadable by torch.load in the GRouNdGAN runtime.
The checkpoint must contain the generator_state_dict and critic_state_dict entries expected by GRouNdGAN's CausalGAN._load method.
The checkpoint must be compatible with the supplied reference AnnData, causal graph, model hyperparameters and causal-controller checkpoint.
